THE GAME

Brawler · Roguelite · Gore

TrashBlood is a fast, hard-hitting top-down brawler. Start with a simple metal pipe and bolt on scrap parts until it becomes a weapon all your own, then trade pieces of your body for implants.

Two ways to play are on the way: an endless horde mode, where every wave is worse than the last and every run builds a different weapon, and a campaign with handcrafted levels, puzzles and bosses you won't meet anywhere else.

Both climb through six worlds, each with its own enemies, from the depths of the landfill all the way up to the heavens.

WHAT'S INSIDE

01

A weapon that grows

The pipe takes scrap parts that stack and combine, so every run ends with a weapon nobody else has.

02

Implants

Trade pieces of your body for implants that open new builds. Your build shows on your character.

03

Every hit lands

Responsive controls, hit-stop, camera shake and enemies that react to every blow.

04

A living arena

The arena is made of tiles that reshape mid-fight and turn into traps, for you and for them.

05

Six worlds

From the landfill to the heavens, each world brings new enemies and a new look.

06

A voice in your ear

A narrator with a strong personality keeps you company, whether you want it or not.
